description: Reflection-manifest policy for the native OpenTelemetry API surface. Every name declared by open-telemetry/api and open-telemetry/context must be classified: match (enforced identical public signature), pending (known gap, warning only), userland_only (must stay a Composer-provided PHP class).

allow.constant:SIGNALS: phper cannot safely register persistent internal array constants; TRACE, METRICS and LOGS are exact

allow.constant:FIELDS: phper cannot safely register persistent internal array constants; fields() returns the exact official values
